name: memex
description: Project memory and a code map for Codex. Archives Codex (and Claude Code) session transcripts into the project, indexes them for full-text search, and answers with pointers to exact line ranges instead of summaries. Shares one archive with the Claude Code plugin.

interface.shortDescription: Project memory and a code map
interface.longDescription: Memex keeps this project's session history in the repository and answers "why did we do it this way" and "which file does this" with exact pointers. The archive is shared with Claude Code, so a decision made in one tool can be found from the other.
defaultPrompt: Why did we decide this earlier in the project?
